title: CLANNAD: Soundtrack Pack
description: 🎵 CLANNAD soundtrack replacing all music in the main menu, Overworld, Nether, and End. 70 tracks, biome-specific, 8 discs. No mods.
body:
---

![Logo Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3139312652f17a3de94ef305f021ca5d46565dd0.jpeg)

> _This video was created for the earlier version of the pack, which only replaced the main menu. The core musical concept remains the same (just massively expanded), so it captures the vibe of this project just as well._

---

![About the Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09f963e1e10e3844c75e51d6b15f7ad28c8e843d.jpeg)

**Complete music replacement** for **Minecraft Java Edition** with the soundtrack from **CLANNAD** and **CLANNAD: After Story**.

This pack replaces **all background music** in the game with **70 carefully selected tracks** from the official CLANNAD OST, including piano arranges, remixes, image songs, and insert songs.

---

![Where does the music play?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c20a765b677f09706a3780a403792700477c7d3c.jpeg)

| Dimension / Area | Details |
|------------------|---------|
| 🏠 **Main Menu** | 4 tracks |
| 🌍 **Overworld** | 44 tracks |
| 🔥 **Nether** | 7 tracks |
| 🟣 **The End** | 3 tracks |
| 🎨 **Creative Mode** | 6 tracks |

---

![Full Track Distribution](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a692ffbef53a874b30a494b09bbc460ba7f6644.jpeg)

| Category | Tracks | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| **Overworld (general)** | 44 | Base music playing everywhere in the Overworld |
| **Creative Mode** | 6 | Additional tracks for creative gameplay |
| **The End** | 3 | Exploration, dragon fight, credits |
| **Nether** | 7 | 4 common + 3 biome-specific (Crimson Forest, Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley) |
| **Main Menu** | 4 | Atmospheric menu tracks |
| **Music Discs** | 8 | Openings and endings (TV-size & Full versions) |

---

![Music Disc Replacements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b30fcf87cf6afc379df3b749f8cf94b9eb0f0103.jpeg)

| Disc | Track |
|------|-------|
| `13` | Opening 1 (Full) |
| `cat` | Opening 1 (TV-size) |
| `far` | Opening 2 (TV-size) |
| `strad` | Opening 2 (Full) |
| `blocks` | Ending 1 (TV-size) |
| `mall` | Ending 1 (Full) |
| `chirp` | Ending 2 (TV-size) |
| `mellohi` | Ending 2 (Full) |

---

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5ba84502298597e60899ce4cf244f182d513516.jpeg)

✅ **70 tracks** from the CLANNAD universe  
✅ **Full music replacement** — no vanilla tracks remain  
✅ **Complete Overworld, Nether, and End coverage**  
✅ **8 music discs replaced** with openings and endings  
✅ **No mods required** — pure vanilla experience  
✅ **Music Toasts display the names of currently playing tracks** — CLANNAD track titles will be displayed in both English and Russian. 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

You can read more about music toasts here: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Toasts

</details>



---

### 🚫 No Mods Required!

This pack works **out of the box** on pure vanilla Minecraft. Just drop it into your resource packs folder and enjoy the full CLANNAD soundtrack experience.
